name: Grilled beef loin
summary: Thăn bò nướng is beef loin grilled with mushrooms or with cải tai mèo greens. The meat is soft and sweet, with a chili heat from the greens.
taste: Soft, sweet beef; the cải tai mèo version adds heat.
howToEat: Order it with mushrooms for a mild plate, or with cải tai mèo for heat.
where: The grill stalls at hồ Sa Pa and on the road down to the market, on cold evenings.
seoTitle: Grilled beef loin in Sapa — mushrooms or greens
seoDescription: Thăn bò nướng with mushrooms or cải tai mèo on the Sa Pa grills: soft, sweet beef with heat from the greens.
